summary: The Meta-Physicist is a pure nano/pet caster: it wins by casting attack/heal/mezz pets, nukes, debuffs and the game's second-best nanoskill buffs, so its gear priorities are nano-skills (MM/BM/PM/MC/TS/SI), the Intelligence + Psychic that raise them, Nano Init (NanoC. Init, stat 0x95) for fast casts, Max Nano / nano pool, NCU, and nano-cost reduction - NOT melee/ranged AC stacking. Best-in-class survivability comes from its pets tanking plus reflect/absorb from symbiants and perks, so armor is chosen for casting output first, ACs last. Leveling path: cheap sided/Carbonum -> nano-skill sets (Living Cyber, Azure Reveries, Sekutek) -> the Shadowlands quest suit -> endgame Miy's Nano, Combined Officer's, or the profession Ofab set. Symbiants and weapons are covered in the separate implants/weapons profiles and are excluded here.

armorSets.name: Miy's Nano Armor
armorSets.source: wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Miy's_Nano_Armor ; aoitems.com/item/268837 (Miy's Nano Body Armor); auno.org/ao/db.php?id=268836
armorSets.note: The nano variety of Miy's; largest bonuses (Int/Psychic) sit on the Head and Arm pieces. Drops from Medusae (e.g. The Reck dyna camp ~lvl 145). Requires Intelligence + Psychic to wear. Top froob/mid-SL nano set and still strong at endgame; often mixed with Combined pieces.

armorSets.name: Combined Officer's Armor
armorSets.levelRange: Endgame (AI); QL225 is highest usable with Alien Technology Expertise 2
armorSets.source: wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Combined_Officer's_Armor ; ao-universe.com Alien Armor Process and List ; anarchyonline.fandom.com/wiki/Alien_Armor
armorSets.note: The nano-caster alien armor: tradeskilled by combining Arithmetic + Spiritual alien armor. Best raw weight of nano + trade skill bonuses in the game for a caster. Requires AI raids for parts and high Psychology/EE/NP to build (6x QL). Endgame BiS body/legs/feet for an MP.

armorSets.name: Ofab Metaphysicist Armor

keyBonuses.Upgradeable: Ofab -> Improved -> Penultimate tiers via Victory Points

armorSets.levelRange: Endgame (Lost Eden); bought/upgraded with Battlestation Victory Points
armorSets.source: wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Meta-Physicist:Armor (Lost Eden section); local itemnames.sql (Ofab Metaphysicist set)
armorSets.note: Profession-specific PvP/PvM set from Battlestation. Convenient full set with a matching Shoulder Wear piece; a common endgame alternative or supplement to Combined/Miy's. Exact per-QL stat lines not fully verified here - see _unverified.

armorSets.name: Metaphysicist Suit (Shadowlands, upgradeable) -> Chosen / Faithful Metaphysicist Suit
armorSets.source: wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Meta-Physicist:Armor ; wiki.aodb.us/wiki/First_Tier_Metaphysicist_Suit ; local itemnames.sql (First/Second Tier, Chosen, Faithful Metaphysicist pieces)
armorSets.note: SL quest chain: First Tier -> Second Tier -> Chosen (Sanctuary) or Faithful (Redeemed) Metaphysicist Suit. Free, no-drop, self-only profession set with Back/Wings and Shoulder pieces. Good leveling backbone through Shadowlands before Miy's/Combined. Detailed nano-skill/init lines per tier not fully verified here.
